full_prompt_en: A square watercolor like painting shows a pale barn owl in close view, nestled among deep red and violet leaves. The owl fills the center and right of the image, with its rounded crown cropped close to the top edge and its body continuing to the bottom. Its heart shaped face is cream and ivory, edged by a fine golden brown outline that follows the cheek toward a small pale beak. A single glossy dark eye is fully visible near the left of the face, framed by warm rust colored shading. The broad upper body is buff and ocher, finely speckled with small darker marks. Along the lower right wing, blue gray and orange brown patches break through the warm breast color, their edges following the form rather than lying flat. On the left, large plum and burgundy leaves overlap against a shadowy green background; smaller crimson shapes gather near the lower corner. Behind the owl, warm green and brown color blurs into an indistinct natural setting, keeping the face and upper shoulder in sharp focus. Fine linear marks describe the short, soft plumage around the cheek, while looser translucent washes define surrounding foliage. Light falls gently from the upper left, making the pale face glow and catching the bird's crown and back, with cooler shade in the left leaf cluster and lower wing. The dark eye offers the most concentrated contrast within a painting otherwise rich in soft tonal changes. The overall composition is close and serene, balancing precise animal detail with a lush, softly dissolved border of color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形近似水彩的绘画近距离描绘一只浅色仓鸮，栖在深红与紫色叶片之间。猫头鹰填满画面中央和右侧，圆润头顶贴近上缘被裁切，身体一直延伸到底边。心形面盘呈奶油色与象牙白，纤细金棕色轮廓沿面颊走向小小浅色喙。脸的左侧附近，一只发亮的深色眼睛完整可见，周围围着暖锈色阴影。宽阔上身为浅黄褐和赭色，细小深色点痕密布其上。右下翅膀上，蓝灰与橙棕斑块穿过暖色胸部，边缘顺着形体走向，而不是平贴其上。左侧，大块李子紫与酒红叶片在暗绿背景前交叠，更小的深红形状聚在下角。猫头鹰身后，暖绿和棕色模糊成难以分辨的自然环境，让脸和上肩保持锐利。细线笔痕描绘面颊周围短而柔软的羽毛，较松散的透明洗色则建立周围叶丛。光从左上温柔地落下，让浅色面盘发亮，并照到头顶和背部；左侧叶群及下方翅膀留着较冷阴影。深色眼睛是整幅充满柔和明暗变化的画面里反差最集中的地方。整体构图贴近而安宁，以精细动物细节平衡丰厚、柔和消散的彩色边缘。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor like painting layers translucent washes beneath precise fine strokes and tiny stippled marks. Cream, pale gold, rusty orange, blue gray, deep plum, and muted green are arranged so a warm luminous center emerges from cooler darker margins. Soft rounded volumes are modeled with many small directional marks, while surrounding broad shapes bleed gently into one another. A single small dark accent can hold the strongest contrast, preventing the varied colors from becoming unfocused. Edges are selective: the focal contours are clear and delicate, and peripheral forms dissolve into diffuse atmospheric color. Subtle paper grain and uneven pigment pooling give the surface a handcrafted quality. Light arrives softly from above one side, warming the raised central planes and leaving deeper cool shade along overlapping outer layers. The overall effect is lush yet quiet, joining meticulous local texture to fluid, spacious color transitions.
style_prompt_zh: 近似水彩的绘画在透明洗色层上叠加精细笔线与微小点痕。奶油色、浅金、锈橙、蓝灰、深李子紫和低饱和绿色经过安排，让温暖发光的中心从较冷较暗的边缘浮现。柔软圆润体积由许多顺着形体方向的小笔痕塑造，周围的宽阔形状则轻轻互相渗化。单一小型深色重音可以承载最强反差，避免多样色彩失去焦点。边缘有选择：焦点轮廓清楚而细腻，外围形体溶入漫射的大气色彩。细微纸张颗粒和不均匀的颜料积聚让表面带手作质感。光从一侧上方柔和到来，温暖中央凸起平面，交叠的外层边缘留在更深的冷阴影里。整体效果丰厚却安静，将精细的局部肌理与流动开阔的色彩过渡结合。
theme_en: A pale barn owl among deep red and violet leaves
theme_zh: 浅色仓鸮栖在深红与紫色叶片之间
name: Ann Mortimer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
